title: Rigid-walled duct modes: cutoff, beating and evanescent near field (analytic)
description:
Water between two rigid walls (elastic_waves bc_y rigid, h = 1.11 mm = 40 cells), 30 mm long with absorbing x ends (60-cell CPML), driven by a cw volume source (1 MHz) at x_s, y_s = 10.5 / 40 h (cell centres); ~40 periods (~1 s).
Analytic (rigid walls: duct modes cos(n pi y / h), cutoff f_n = n c / (2 h) = 0.667 n MHz): p = (Omega rho Q / (2 h)) sum_n eps_n cos(n pi y / h) cos(n pi y_s / h) x [sin(w t - k_n |x - x_s|) / k_n for n = 0, 1 (propagating) | exp(-kappa_n |x - x_s|) cos(w t) / kappa_n for n >= 2 (evanescent, decay length 0.27 mm for n = 2)], eps_0 = 1, eps_n = 2. Modes 0 and 1 beat with period 2 pi / (k_0 - k_1) = 5.8 mm along the duct. The parameters use the exact discrete form of this sum: k_n from sin^2(k_n dx / 2) = (dx sin(pi f dt) / (c dt))^2 - sin^2(n pi / (2 N)), kappa_n likewise with sinh, 1 / k_n -> dx / sin(k_n dx) (1 / kappa_n -> dx / sinh(kappa_n dx)) and w -> Omega = 2 sin(w dt / 2) / dt (each within ~2e-3 of the continuum).
Derived values tab: pp_mean_a / pp_mean_b = time mean of 2 p^2 over the last 10 periods at two probes (5.6 mm and 9.4 mm from the source, both far beyond the evanescent field) vs B0^2 + B1^2 + 2 B0 B1 cos((k_0 - k_1) |x - x_s|), B1 including cos(pi y / h) of the probe; expected < 1 % (CPML reflection of the oblique mode-1 waves ~1e-3), tolerance 2 %.
Line profile tab (final state): p_axial along the duct at y = 30.5 / 40 h from 20 cells past the source to the CPML (the beat plus the decaying near field), p_transverse across the duct 20 cells from the source (modes 0..5); tolerance 2 % of the range.
Probes tab: probe_a / probe_b with the steady state (dashed; exact after the switch-on ramp and the mode-1 group delay, ~20 us).

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: source frequency (1.5 x the first cutoff)

parameters.name: c_w
parameters.description: sound speed of water in m/s

parameters.name: h_duct
parameters.description: duct height (rigid wall to rigid wall, the grid edges)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (27.75 um, 53 cells per wavelength)

parameters.name: L_duct
parameters.description: duct length (30 mm, incl. the 60-cell absorbing layers inside it)

parameters.name: Q_rate
parameters.description: peak volume injection rate per m of z in m^2/s

parameters.name: dt_ac
parameters.description: acoustic step of the fluid on square cells (1.19e-8 s)

parameters.name: Omega_d
parameters.description: discrete angular frequency of the leap-frog time derivative

parameters.name: s_w
parameters.description: (Omega dx / (2 c))^2: the discrete dispersion budget sin^2(k_x dx/2) + sin^2(k_y dy/2)

parameters.name: P_pre
parameters.description: duct Green's function prefactor Omega rho Q / (2 h) in Pa/m

parameters.name: B1
parameters.description: mode-1 amplitude in Pa (times cos(pi y / h))

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: final time: the tick nearest T_run

parameters.name: x_a
parameters.description: probe_a x (200 cells past the source)

parameters.name: y_a
parameters.description: probe_a y and the axial line height

parameters.name: x_b
parameters.description: probe_b x (340 cells before the source)

parameters.name: B1_a
parameters.description: mode-1 amplitude at probe_a in Pa

parameters.name: B1_b
parameters.description: mode-1 amplitude at probe_b in Pa

parameters.name: x_cut
parameters.description: x of the transverse line (0.56 mm from the source)

analytic_curves.name: p_axial
analytic_curves.expression: B0*sin(w_ang*t_end - k_0*abs(x - x_s)) + B1*cos(pi*y/h_duct)*sin(w_ang*t_end - k_1*abs(x - x_s)) + (C2*cos(2*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_2*abs(x - x_s)) + C3*cos(3*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_3*abs(x - x_s)) + C4*cos(4*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_4*abs(x - x_s)) + C5*cos(5*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_5*abs(x - x_s)))*cos(w_ang*t_end)

analytic_curves.name: p_transverse
analytic_curves.expression: B0*sin(w_ang*t_end - k_0*abs(x - x_s)) + B1*cos(pi*y/h_duct)*sin(w_ang*t_end - k_1*abs(x - x_s)) + (C2*cos(2*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_2*abs(x - x_s)) + C3*cos(3*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_3*abs(x - x_s)) + C4*cos(4*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_4*abs(x - x_s)) + C5*cos(5*pi*y/h_duct)*exp(-kap_5*abs(x - x_s)))*cos(w_ang*t_end)

analytic_curves.name: probe_a_steady
analytic_curves.expression: B0*sin(w_ang*t - k_0*abs(x_a - x_s)) + B1_a*sin(w_ang*t - k_1*abs(x_a - x_s))

analytic_curves.name: probe_b_steady
analytic_curves.expression: B0*sin(w_ang*t - k_0*abs(x_b - x_s)) + B1_b*sin(w_ang*t - k_1*abs(x_b - x_s))
